subject: Compact exec availability — lock window for InteropPilot demo
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Kuznetsov <sasha.k@solsticeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Compact exec availability — lock window for InteropPilot demo

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for the time on the discovery call last week. Per our conversation, the InteropPilot demo that shows multi-region routing and dedicated fallback looks like the best fit to align with SolsticeAI’s latency and compliance ask. We want to keep the exec portion tight (30–40 minutes) so your CIO and VP of Infrastructure get the decision-critical view and we don’t take more of their calendar than necessary.

Do either of these work on your side for a 40-minute slot (we’ll follow with a 20-minute technical deep-dive if you want):
- Tuesday 14 May, 11:00–11:40 PT
- Thursday 16 May, 08:30–09:10 PT

If neither works, a fallback window is Friday 17 May, 15:00–15:40 PT.

I’m copying Marissa and Ben so they can confirm coverage (exec walk-through + engineering Q&A). I’ve attached a concise run-of-show and an exec one-pager so you can share with the sponsors.

Next steps: if you confirm a slot I’ll send the calendar hold + run-of-show and mark attendee roles (VP/CIO/CTO). If you prefer a single joined session instead of two, tell us and we’ll compress the technical detail.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0171

Attachments: interop-demo-runofshow.pdf (12 KB), interop-exec-onepager.docx (9 KB)

From: Sasha Kuznetsov <sasha.k@solsticeai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@solsticeai.com>
Date: 2029-05-07T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact exec availability — lock window for InteropPilot demo

Camila —

Thanks for the clear options and the one-pager. Quick answers from our side:
- CIO (Daniel Park) prefers mornings but can make the 11:00 PT slot on Tuesday 14 May if we keep it tight.
- VP Infrastructure (me) can also do that slot.

Two small asks before we lock: can you ensure the exec portion skips the low-level kernel stuff and focuses on SLA guarantees, failover behavior (regional failover), and an example cost delta for our steady-state requests? Also, is there an NDA or procurement step we should start now for Dedicated capacity pricing?

If Tuesday 11:00 is on the table, please send the calendar hold and who will present.

Thanks,
Sasha
Sasha Kuznetsov
VP Infrastructure | SolsticeAI
sasha.k@solsticeai.com

Perfect — locking Tuesday 14 May 11:00–11:40 PT for the exec walkthrough. Calendar hold coming in one minute.

Agenda (exec 40'):
1) 5' — Quick context and objectives (Camila)
2) 15' — Reliability & routing: regional failover, SLA behavior (Marissa)
3) 10' — Cost profile and steady-state delta between hosted vs. dedicated for your workload (Ben)
4) 6' — Decision recap and procurement next steps (Camila)
4b) 4' — Q&A / immediate blockers

On procurement: we’ve started an internal pricing worksheet tied to SOL-1734 and I’ll share the Dedicated capacity brief as an attachment to the invite. If you need an NDA before the technical deep dive, we can push that to legal — we usually execute via DocuSign; I’ll include the link in the invite notes.

Presenters: Camila (context & procurement), Marissa Cole (reliability/routing), Ben Carter (cost modeling).

Ben/Marissa — can you both confirm you’ll be on the call and whether you want any pre-read for the technical deep-dive? I can split the 20-minute follow-up into two slots: an engineering deep-dive with your team (1 hour) and a longer SRE-level Q&A (30 minutes) — if you think that helps.

Thanks everyone — sending the invite and attachments now.

Best,
Camila

All good from my side — I’ll take the reliability & routing section and will prepare two short slides that visualize our multi-region failover (warm-standby + KV cache warmup timeline) and the graceful fallback to a quantized model variant. No low-level kernel diagrams in the exec deck.

Ben — can you confirm the cost delta example you plan to show is the steady-state 50k tokens/day scenario (p95 sequence length) I sent earlier? If you want, I can attach a simplified diagram to the calendar invite showing the routing policy match that triggers Dedicated fallback.

Camila — NDA note: if Solstice prefers it we can attach a standard one-page mutual NDA to the invite; otherwise we’ll wait until they ask. I’ll also add a 1-slide appendix with the procurement path (Reserved capacity timeline + milestone triggers) so Daniel has an immediate next-step view.
